detail.longDescription:
Meet Claude, your AI problem solver and thinking partner. Claude works with you to write, research, code, and tackle complex problems and hard questions with depth and precision. It enhances your thinking and expands what you're capable of, right from your phone.

AI ASSISTANT FOR TASKS

Get AI assistance on everyday tasks like filling out forms, planning a trip, drafting a reply, or making sense of a long document. Connect to your email account, file drives, and other tools so it can actually get stuff done for you. Nothing goes out without your approval.

More than just an AI chat app, Claude is a digital assistant for work and life, helping you move through to-do lists and think through parts that need more than a quick answer.

AI WRITING ASSISTANT

Whether you're crafting social media posts, professional emails, or complex reports, Claude refines tone, structure, and clarity, with each iteration. Get writing support from a smart writing assistant that understands what you're trying to say, even when you're still figuring it out.

AI CODING AND PROGRAMMING 

Your AI coding partner, Claude Code, helps you to review code, debug complex issues, and explore new languages. Work through problems in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and dozens of other languages—from quick scripts to multi-step architecture.

Use Claude as your coding assistant to plan multi-step tasks, pull in relevant context, and adapt the approach as your project evolves. Write programs through natural conversation and use Claude to identify and fix errors faster. It scales from a single function to enterprise-level development.

WORK RESEARCH AND DATA INSIGHTS

Go deeper on the questions that matter. Search the web, compile findings with accurate citations, and highlight what's useful. Connect Google Drive, Gmail, and Calendar to bring context into the conversation. Whether you're conducting business analysis, project research, or exploring new ideas, Claude thinks through problems with you, from the first question to the one you didn’t know to ask.

AI PRODUCTIVITY ASSISTANT

Teach Claude your workflows and assign recurring tasks that eat up your day. Task automation gives you time back, so your productivity goes toward your work.

VISUAL ANALYSIS

Upload any photo, PDF, or screenshot for instant analysis. Claude extracts text, interprets charts and graphs, evaluates UI layouts and technical diagrams, and explains what it sees. Get thoughtful feedback on app designs and data visualizations. Generate SVG code for graphics and illustrations, right from your phone.

NO TYPING NEEDED

Think out loud. Use Claude as your AI voice assistant to have conversations on the app in multiple languages—perfect for brainstorming sessions or working through ideas on the go.

EXPAND WHAT YOU CAN DO

Claude helps you:
▶ Develop and refine content with AI writing
▶ Work through meeting notes to surface key insights
▶ Build reports and marketing content iteratively with a reliable AI generator
▶ Explore complex math problems with step-by-step reasoning
▶ Plan projects, structure ideas, and build flowcharts together
▶ Analyze PDFs, screenshots, and visual content for deeper patterns
▶ Think through problems hands-free with voice dictation

TRUSTED AND RELIABLE

Claude is designed to be reliable, accurate, and collaborative. It’s built by Anthropic, an AI research company dedicated to building safe and dependable AI tools. Powered by Claude Fable, Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku, it brings advanced reasoning, creativity, and problem-solving capabilities to your most important challenges.

TRY CLAUDE FOR FREE

Join millions of users who trust Claude for their work on the problems that matter. Whether you're coding, writing, researching, or tackling business challenges, Claude helps you think deeper and reach further.
